name: usage-meter-pills
description: Pill-style band above the prompt: plan limits, context window, git branch and more, each switchable. Options: /usage-meter-options

style.title: Style
style.description: Pills, glass, rings, thin bars, segments or stacked

roundPills.title: Fully rounded pills
roundPills.description: Use fully rounded pills instead of rounded rectangles

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Full pills, compact (icon and percent only) or auto

showPaceMarker.title: Pace marker
showPaceMarker.description: Mark how far through each limit window you are

alertColors.title: Alert colors
alertColors.description: Amber or red when a limit is nearly used or used faster than time passes

showContext.title: Context window
showContext.description: Show how full the context window is

warnContext.title: Context warning
warnContext.description: Turn the context pill red and warn when it is nearly full

showGit.title: Git branch
showGit.description: Show the current branch, with a dot when there are changes

colorSevenDay.title: Weekly color
colorSevenDay.description: Accent color of the weekly pill

colorContext.title: Context color
colorContext.description: Accent color of the context pill

colorFiveHourHex.title: 5-hour custom color
colorFiveHourHex.description: Hex color used when the 5-hour color is custom, like #3fb58a

colorSevenDayHex.title: Weekly custom color
colorSevenDayHex.description: Hex color used when the weekly color is custom

colorContextHex.title: Context custom color
colorContextHex.description: Hex color used when the context color is custom

showTokens.title: Session tokens
showTokens.description: Show input, output and cache tokens

showCost.title: Session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost

showOptionsButton.title: Settings button
showOptionsButton.description: Show a gear next to the band that opens the options
